# `ds/data` Data Dictionary

This folder is the "database" for `ds` data: each parquet file here is a table, synced by a `ds data <command>` and
is the current source of truth for its domain. `raw/` holds the scripts (and any hand-copied source data) used to
produce them.

**AI/Copilot instructions:** whenever you add/rename/remove a column produced by `ds/data/raw/*.py` or change what
a `ds data <command>` writes, update the matching table below in the same change. Keep this file in sync with the
actual parquet schemas — treat a schema change without a README update as an incomplete task.

**Querying these tables:** each table below documents its primary key and any foreign keys into other tables, so you
can join across these files the same way you would join SQL tables. Load with polars, eg:

```python
import polars as pl

char_df = pl.read_parquet("pkgs/ds/data/char.parquet")
framedata_df = pl.read_parquet("pkgs/ds/data/framedata.parquet")

# join framedata.parquet -> char.parquet on the character/id foreign key
little_mac_moves = framedata_df.join(char_df, left_on="char_id", right_on="id").filter(pl.col("char_id") == "little_mac")
```

## `char.parquet`

Character roster. Synced via `ds data roster` (see [raw/roster.py](raw/roster.py)), scraped from
[ultimateframedata.com/smash](https://ultimateframedata.com/smash).

- **Primary key:** `id`
- **Grain:** one row per character

| column          | description                                                                 |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`            | Character URL slug (eg `little_mac`), matches the ultimateframedata.com path |
| `name`          | Character display name (eg `Little Mac`)                                     |
| `framedata_url` | Full ultimateframedata.com URL for this character's move frame data          |

## `framedata.parquet`

Per-move frame data for one or all characters. Synced via `ds data framedata [character]` (see
[raw/framedata.py](raw/framedata.py)), scraped from each character's ultimateframedata.com page.

- **Primary key:** (`char_id`, `category`, `move`)
- **Foreign key:** `char_id` -> `char.parquet.id`
- **Grain:** one row per move per character

| column            | description                                                                          |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `char_id`         | Character id, foreign key to `char.parquet.id`                                        |
| `category`        | Move category heading (eg `Ground Attacks`, `Aerial Attacks`, `Special Attacks`, `Grabs / Throws`, `Dodges / Rolls`) |
| `move`            | Move name (eg `Jab 1`, `Forward Air`)                                                 |
| `startup`         | Startup frames                                                                         |
| `totalframes`     | Total frames for the move                                                             |
| `landinglag`      | Landing lag frames (aerials only)                                                     |
| `notes`           | Free-text notes from the site (eg autocancel timing, armor, meter fill)               |
| `basedamage`      | Base damage %                                                                          |
| `shieldlag`       | Frames of shield lag on block                                                         |
| `shieldstun`      | Frames of shield stun on block                                                        |
| `whichhitbox`     | Label for which hitbox variant a stat applies to, when a move has multiple hitboxes   |
| `advantage`       | Frame advantage/disadvantage on shield                                                |
| `activeframes`    | Active hitbox frames                                                                   |
| `endlag`          | End lag frames                                                                        |
| `hopsautocancel`  | Autocancel window (aerials only)                                                       |
| `hopsactionable`  | Which jump types (SH/FH/SHFF/FHFF) the move is actionable before landing (aerials only) |

_NOTE: most fields are stored as raw strings (not parsed numerics) since the site uses `--`, `**`, and slash-separated
multi-hitbox values (eg `10/17`) that don't cleanly coerce to a single numeric type._

## `raw/`

See [raw/readme.md](raw/readme.md) for hand-copied/untransformed source data and the scripts that scrape live sites.
